name: enter_dungeon_room
purpose: Enters a dungeon room (cell type 0xa0 cleared room / 0xf0 room). Prints 'Entering room...', sets g_dungeon_facing from g_dungeon_dir_copy through the 5-byte table 0x2c76 (00 01 02 03 00), flushes the keyboard, clears g_active_member/g_active_combatant (0xff), zeroes 0x160 bytes of g_light_map and loads room (cell&0xf) of the dungeon from DUNGEON.CBT (offset (loc-0x21)*0x1600 + room*0x160, but for loc>0x21 the index is loc-0x22 - quirk kept). Saves monster slots 1-2 (0x5c62..0x5c71), party x/y and g_location (-> 0x5894), sets g_location=0xff, g_combat_exit=0, calls DNGLOOK b40e(3, cell), refresh_map_view, g_combat_flags=0x82 and the COMBAT room loop ae24. When ae24 returns 0 the room was finished: combat exit 'M' runs ENDGAME a8d8; location restored, DNGLOOK aad4(room), and the room cell's bits 0x50 are cleared (0xf0->0xa0 = cleared room). Always restores location, x/y, DNGLOOK b26a, the two monster slots and the active member.

0x5c62.name: g_monster_slot1
0x5c62.meaning: dungeon monster record + previous position (slot 2) saved/restored around the room

notes: shared address with TOWN_81d0/MAINOUT_81d0; the catalog name TOWN_81d0 is a mislabel. Strings 0x2c58 'Entering room...', 0x2c6a 'dungeon.cbt'.

name: spawn_dungeon_monster
purpose: (Re)spawns the single wandering dungeon monster and reloads its sprite file. If respawn!=0: k=rand(0..7) is stored in both bytes of 0x5c62/0x5c63, anim byte 0x5c68 = table 0x1744[k] (60 a0 00 90 80 60 00 00), type 0x5c67 = table 0x173c[k] (14 15 16 17 18 19 1c 1b), z 0x5c66 = party level, alt flag 0x5c69 = 0; the previous MONn.16 segment (0xa9c6) is freed if a monster existed, then place_dungeon_monster() picks a cell; on failure kind is zeroed and type set to 0xff (none). Then if a monster exists, load_image_file(g_raw_file_names[8+k]) (0x25fa + k*2 -> MON0..MON7.16) is retried until it returns a non-zero segment, stored in 0xa9c6. ROOT 3c9a (leaving a dungeon camp/room) calls it with respawn=0 to just reload the sprite.
notes: vector 1778:04fa

name: print_level_and_facing
purpose: Updates the two labels in the dungeon frame: selects text window 0, prints the level number (g_party_z+1, width 1, pad 0x20) at cursor (0,12) - right after the 'L ' label - and the facing word at cursor (23,12) after 'Dir:': 0 'North' (0x2c7c), 1 ' East' (0x2c82), 2 'South' (0x2c88), 3 ' West' (0x2c8e), else ' ????' (0x2c94). Restores the previously selected text window.

name: place_dungeon_monster
purpose: Chooses a cell on the party's level for the wandering monster. Up to 8 attempts: cell=rand(0..63); the cell qualifies if its type nibble is <0x60 (hallway/ladders/chest/fountain) or ==0x70 (open chest) AND cell%8 != party x AND cell/8 != party y. On success monster x/y (0x5c64/0x5c65) and previous x/y (0x5c6c/0x5c6d) are set to the cell; for monster types 0x16 and 0x18 the alternate sprite flag 0x5c69 becomes 0xff when rand(0..99)>0x30; returns 1. After 8 failures the four position bytes are set to 0xff and 0 is returned.
notes: the decompiled sign-preserving >>3 is just cell/8 for 0..63

name: draw_dungeon_frame
purpose: Draws the static frame around the first-person view on page 0: fill_rect in g_ui_color2 of x 0x28..0x98 rows 0..7 and x 0x30..0x98 rows 0xb9..0xbf; draw_line in g_ui_color1 along row 7 (x 0x28..0x98) and row 0xb8 (x 0x30..0x98); then in text window 0 prints the capped labels 'L ' (0x2c9a) at cursor (0,10) and 'Dir:      ' (0x2c9d) at (23,6) using draw_bar_left_cap/right_cap. Restores the previously selected window.
notes: set_color is passed a stray second argument (g_cur_window) in the decompile - ignored

name: read_dungeon_command
purpose: Waits for a command key while animating the first-person view. If g_status_dirty, redraws the status window and clears the flag. Prints '\n' and the prompt cap, then loops: key = to_upper(poll_key_with_cursor()); a key 1..4 not from the keypad (g_key_from_keypad==0) is remapped to 0xfb..0xfe (direction codes). While key==0 it calls render_dungeon_view(anim) (page 1), copies the view to page 0 with copy_rect_between_pages (rows 0xe..0xb2; x 0x10..0xaf when anim!=0 else x 0x28..0x96), clears anim unless g_dungeon_style==1 (cave: animated), and runs step_sound_tick. Returns the key once non-zero.
notes: anim=1 for the first frame always (full-width copy), afterwards only in caves

name: electric_field_push
purpose: Handles walking into an electric energy field (cell 0x83). Redraws the view, prints 'Ouch!' (0x2ca8) and 'Electric field!' (0x2caf), XOR-fills the view rect (x 8..0xb7, y 8..0xb7) in g_ui_color1, waits 1 tick, XOR-fills again (flash), play_random_tones(20000,500,1) - the 20000 is the address 0x4e13+0xd used as a number. Then moves the party one cell against the step direction: step<1 (backing up) adds the facing's dx/dy (low bytes of the i16 tables 0x24d6/0x24de), step>=1 subtracts them; x/y wrap as bytes (no &7 here). damage_whole_party, redraw.

name: move_in_dungeon
purpose: Executes a movement command (Ghidra param_1=cell the party stands on, param_2=cmd). cmd 1 'Turn left' (facing+3)&3 and 2 'Turn right' (facing+1)&3 are refused with 'Not in doorway!' (0x2cef/0x2cc9) when the cell type is 0xe0 (door); 3 'Advance' step=+1; 4 'Back up' step=-1; any other cmd (0xd Enter, 0x2e '.') prints 'Turn around.' and adds 2 to the facing. g_dungeon_dir_copy = facing. For a step: target nx = dx[facing]*step + x, ny likewise, wrapped (<0 -> 7, >7 -> 0). If the target cell is 0x83 (electric field) the party is moved onto it and electric_field_push(step) runs; the target is then re-read from the party position. With t = type nibble: passable if t<=0xa0 or t>=0xe0, except that backing up (step==-1) into 0xa0/0xf0 (rooms) is blocked ('Blocked!' 0x2d19, also for walls 0xb0..0xd0). If the target equals the monster's x/y: 'Blocked!' (0x2d23). Otherwise 0xa9fb=0xf, 0x24e7=0, step_sound_tick(), 0x24e7=0 and party x/y = target & 7. Always ends with redraw_dungeon_view(); returns 1 if a step was attempted (even if blocked), else 0.
notes: advancing into a door/room cell is allowed (rooms are entered by dungeon_turn_events afterwards)

name: dungeon_command
purpose: Dispatches one dungeon command key and returns the 'time passes' flag. 0xb (^K, debug): print_number(karma) + newline, return 1. 1..4 (direction codes), 0xd (Enter) and 0x2e ('.') -> move_in_dungeon(cell under the party, key) (Enter/'.' act as 'Turn around.'). 5 (^E): 'Exit to DOS? ' (0x2d2d); on 'Y' restore_video_mode + exit(0), else prints 'N' (0x2d3b), return 1. 0x13 (^S): prints 'Sound ' then 'On'/'Off' and toggles the low byte of g_sound_enabled, return 1. 0x16 (^V): prints '1.16' + newline, return 1. Digits '0'..'9': set_active_player(key), return 0. Everything else: return dispatch_command(key).
notes: the 0xfb..0xfe arrow codes produced by read_dungeon_command fall into dispatch_command (which maps them back to the dungeon move keys in ROOT); keys 1..4 reach move_in_dungeon directly only when typed from the keypad

name: move_dungeon_monster
purpose: Moves the wandering monster one random step on the party's level. No-op (returns 0) if type==-1; type 0x1b never moves. Up to 8 tries: dir=rand(0..3); target = x+dx[dir], y+dy[dir], each wrapped (>7->0, <0->7); the target is accepted if its cell type is not 0x60 (pit), not 0x80 (field) and <0xa0 (no wall/door/room) and, if it equals the previous position, only when rand(0..7)==1. On acceptance prev x/y := x/y and x/y := target. Then if the monster x/y equals the party x/y it is moved back to its previous position and 1 is returned (= the monster attacks), else 0.

name: sleep_field_effect
purpose: Sleep energy field (cells 0x80/0x88). Prints 'Sleep spell!' (0x2d53). For each party member i<g_party_count: r=rand(1..30); if dex[i] <= r and status != 'D' then status='S', highlight_party_line(i), play_random_tones(3500,50,1), g_status_dirty=1. Finally the party's dungeon cell is ANDed with 8 (field removed, ceiling-hole bit kept).
notes: shared address with TOWN/MAINOUT 8b18

name: poison_field_effect
purpose: Poison energy field (cells 0x81/0x89). Prints 'Poison!' (0x2d61); for each member with dex <= rand(1..30) and status != 'D': status='P' and play_random_tones(3500,50,1). The field cell is left intact and no dirty flag is set (dungeon_turn_events redraws the status window).
notes: the ROOT vector 1778:036e (vec_TOWN_8bb6) lists it as a callee only because of the shared address

name: fall_through_pit
purpose: Invisible pit trap handler. g_dungeon_dir_copy=5. While cell is 0x61 or 0x69 (hidden floor hole, +ceiling hole) and g_party_z<8: prints 'Pit Trap!' (0x2d6a) and 'Falling...' (0x2d75), clears bits 0-2 of the current cell (the trap is sprung/removed), g_party_z++, reads the cell below at the same x/y; if it is <0x90 it gets bit 8 (visible ceiling hole) and is written back; redraw_dungeon_view, '      ...splat!' (0x2d81), damage_whole_party; the loop continues if the landing cell is itself a hidden pit. If z reached 8 the party fell out of the dungeon: g_location=0 (ROOT main then runs the overworld with g_party_z=8 -> the ROOT code handles the Underworld drop). Otherwise, if the landing cell is a room (0xa0/0xf0): DNGLOOK b3c0, enter_dungeon_room(cell), return if g_location became 0, DNGLOOK b32e(1); then spawn_dungeon_monster(1).
notes: with z==8 the landing-cell read indexes past g_dungeon_map (harmless in the emulated DGROUP)

name: dungeon_monster_attacks
purpose: The wandering monster stepped onto the party. Prints 'Attacked' (0x2d92); the attack direction is derived from the monster's previous cell: (prev_x-1)&7==x -> 1 (east), (prev_x+1)&7==x -> 3 (west), (prev_y-1)&7==y -> 2 (south), else 0 (north), stored in g_dungeon_dir_copy. If it differs from g_dungeon_facing: ' from the ' + 'north'/'east'/'south'/'west' (0x2da6/0x2dac/0x2db1/0x2db7) and the party turns to face it. Prints '!' (0x2dbc), redraw_dungeon_view, flush_keyboard, wait_ticks(2), DNGLOOK b3c0, g_combat_exit=0, g_combat_flags=2, DNGLOOK afce, run_encounter(0, monster type, 2), DNGLOOK b26a, DNGLOOK b32e(1), spawn_dungeon_monster(1), and redraw if g_location!=0.
notes: the asm shows both argument-less calls in the decompile push 1

name: dungeon_turn_events
purpose: End-of-turn processing after a command that consumed time. Each sleeping member ('S') wakes ('G') with probability 4/64; if any woke, draw_status_window. If monsters_move, move_dungeon_monster(); when it returns 1, dungeon_monster_attacks() and the cell is re-read. Cell type 0xf0/0xa0 (room): DNGLOOK b3c0, then while the cell is still a room and find_first_conscious_member()>=0: enter_dungeon_room(cell), stop if g_location==0, re-read the cell; then DNGLOOK b32e(1), redraw if g_location>0x20, and only end_of_turn_party_update (no status redraw). Otherwise exact cell values: 0x80/0x88 sleep_field_effect; 0x81/0x89 poison_field_effect; 0x82/0x8a 'Fire!!' (0x2dbf) + damage_whole_party; 0x61/0x69 fall_through_pit; 0x62/0x6a 'Bomb Trap!' 'KABOOM!!' (0x2dc7/0x2dd3), cell &= 8, damage_whole_party. Then draw_status_window and end_of_turn_party_update.
notes: energy field 0x83 (electric) is handled in move_in_dungeon, not here

name: dungeon_main
purpose: Dungeon game loop, vector 1778:0296, called by ROOT main when 0x21<=g_location<=0x28 (arrived = 1 when entering from outside). g_dungeon_flags=2; DNGLOOK abca (loads DNGn.16/ITEMS.16 unless flag bit 1); draw_dungeon_frame; print_level_and_facing. Tile set by location-0x20: 1,4,5 -> g_dungeon_wall_tile=0x4f, floor 0x45, style 3; else wall 0x4d, floor 5, style 2 for 6,7, style 1 otherwise. If the start cell is a room (0xa0/0xf0): DNGLOOK b3c0 + enter_dungeon_room. If still in a dungeon: DNGLOOK b32e(arrived), spawn_dungeon_monster(arrived), redraw_dungeon_view. Loop: exit when running==0 or g_location<0x21 (then g_dungeon_flags bit 4 is set if bit 2 is clear, else bit 4 cleared; DNGLOOK b3c0; BLCKTHRN resurrection_scene if find_first_conscious_member returned -1). first=find_first_conscious_member(): 1 (all asleep) prints '\n' + cap + 'Zzzzzz...' and loops without a command; -1 stops the loop; time_passes=(first>=0). With first==0: g_status_icon 'T' -> no pass_time and monsters_move=0; 'Q' -> monsters_move toggles each turn and pass_time(1) only when it becomes 1; else monsters_move=1, pass_time(1). key=read_dungeon_command(); if key>=0 time_passes=dungeon_command(key); leaving the dungeon clears time_passes/running; if time_passes, dungeon_turn_events(monsters_move, cell).

0xbb17.name: g_dungeon_flags
0xbb17.meaning: bit1 images loaded (DNGLOOK), bit2 set by dungeon_main, bit4 toggled on exit

notes: Ghidra's in_stack_0000fff4 is the local 'time passes' flag; the garbage arguments to FUN_1778_02de are artefacts (it takes none)

name: step_sound_tick
purpose: Footstep sound driver called once per view frame and once per step. Toggles the byte 0x24e7 (^1); when it became 1 and the countdown 0xa9fb is non-zero, play_random_tones(20000, countdown, 1) and sub_u8_floor(4, &0xa9fb) (countdown -= 4, floored at 0). move_in_dungeon primes 0xa9fb=0xf and 0x24e7=0 before/after an explicit tick, so a step yields tones of total 15, 11, 7, 3 on alternate frames.
notes: 20000 is the address 0x4e13+0xd used as the max-frequency argument

name: draw_dungeon_sign
purpose: Renders the rune text of wall sign sign_no (1..count, the low nibble of a 0xb1.. cell) of the current dungeon at the near wall. Per-dungeon tables indexed by g_location (0x21..0x28, addressed as 0x2dc7+loc and 0x2dcf+loc): first sign index 0x2de8 = 00 01 02 02 03 07 0a 0b, sign count 0x2df0 = 01 01 00 01 04 03 01 00. If sign_no<=count: i=base+sign_no; cell position x=0x2df7[i] (00 07 08 08 08 09 09 09 0a 09 09 07), y=0x2e03[i] (00 0a 09 0a 0b 0a 0a 0a 0b 0b 0b 0a); define_text_window(0x18,0x27,y,x,0) redefines window 0 there, select window 0, font 1 (runes), cursor (0,0), put_char(0xfd), print_string(g_dungeon_sign_text_ptrs[i-1]) (0x2e10: 11 DGROUP pointers to the texts at 0x6bb0..0x6c38), put_char(0xfd), font 0, select window 2, define_text_window(0x18,0x27,0,0,0).
notes: Ghidra expresses the table bases as s_Bomb_Trap_ (0x2dc7) and s_Bomb_Trap_+8; window 2 is presumably the message window

name: dungeon_cell_at
purpose: Returns g_dungeon_map[g_party_z][y&7][x&7]; for values below 0x90 (everything but walls/doors/rooms) bit 8 (visible ceiling hole / sprung-trap marker) is cleared so renderers see the plain type. Ghidra param_1 = y (multiplied by 8), param_2 = x.
notes: coordinates wrap (torus) like the movement code

name: draw_dungeon_monster
purpose: Draws the wandering monster at view depth 1..3 and steps its animation byte 0x5c68 (bits 0x60 animation kind, 0x90 facing bits, 0x0f frame). Time stop ('T'): anim reset from 0x1744[kind], both halves use image set 1. Else set_l/set_r each = (rand(0..100)<50); kind 0x20: both = (frame==0) and frame = that; kind 0x60: frame = (frame-1) wrapping to 3, set_l = 0x2e26[frame]>>1, set_r = 0x2e26[frame]&1 (table 01 03 02 03); kind 0x40 keeps the random sets. If facing bits set: set_r = ((anim&0x90)==0x90) XOR set_l. With no sprite segment (0xa9c6==0) prints 'Hey!! What's going on here???' (0x6c4e). Else draw_image(mode=alt, y=0x2e32[alt][depth], x=0x2e2a[depth], index=set_l*3+depth-1, seg) for the left half and draw_image_alt (mirrored) at x=0x60 with index set_r*3+depth-1 for the right half; mode=alt (0x5c69==0xff) is driver flag bit 0 = vertical flip. Finally 0x5c68 = kind + facing bits + frame.
notes: MONn.16 has 6 images: 3 depths x 2 animation sets, each the left half of the sprite

name: draw_energy_field
purpose: Draws an energy field at view depth 0..3 as random horizontal line fragments, clipping disabled. Colour (bright, +8): type 0 sleep g_ui_color4, 1 poison g_ui_color3, 2 fire g_ui_color0, 3 electric g_ui_color2 (other types keep the current colour). Per depth: count g_field_lines 0x2e52 (300 100 50 15), width-1 g_field_line_width 0x2e5a (7 7 5 2), top g_field_top 0x2e42 (0x10 0x38 0x50 0x5c), bottom g_field_bottom 0x2e4a (0xa7 0x87 0x6f 0x63). Each line: x=rand(top..bottom-width), y=rand(top..bottom), draw_hline(x..x+width, y). Restores g_clip_enabled.

name: draw_wall_image
proto: void draw_wall_image(int side, int flip, u16 index)
purpose: Blits one view image to page 1. side 0 = left half via draw_image, 1 = right half via draw_image_alt (mirrored, entry 33). index<0x1f: a DNGn.16 wall slice (segment 0xa9c0) at y 0x0e, x = u16 table 0x2e62[side][index&3] (left 0x10 0x28 0x48 0x58; right 0x98 0x78 0x68 0x60), except right-side indices 8..15 and 0x18..0x1b use x 0x60; mode 0. index>=0x1f: an ITEMS.16 object (segment 0xa9c4): i=index+1, image=(i>>1)-0x10, k=(i&6)>>1 (depth 0..3); x = 0x2e72[k] (0x38 0x48 0x50 0x58) for the left half, 0x60 for the right; y: image<8 -> 0x60 if !flip else 0x2e82[k] (0x0f 0x27 0x47 0x57); image>=8 -> 0x2e7a[flip][k] (0x98 0x78 0x68 0x60 / 0x0f 0x27 0x47 0x57). flip is passed as the driver mode (bit 0 = vertical flip: ladders up are the ladder-down image flipped onto the ceiling).
notes: wall images are 164 rows tall (y 0x0e..0xb1); index encoding for items: 0x1f+2*(img-?)... callers pass table values + depth*2

name: animate_wall_sparkle
proto: int animate_wall_sparkle(int depth, int state, int y, int x)
purpose: Sparkle on the cave alternate wall (0xc0). state 5: resets to 0 and play_tone_sweep(total=20-8*depth, step 1, 3500 -> 3200). Else: colour g_ui_color2, or for state 4 colour 3 (CGA/Hercules) / 0xb; draws hline x-1..x+1 at y and vline y-1..y+1 at x; for state<4 plots the centre pixel in bright g_ui_color2 (+8). Then state++ if it was non-zero or with probability 4/64 (rand(0..64)<4). Returns the new state; callers keep it in the low 3 bits of the map cell. Ghidra param_3 is y, param_4 is x.

name: draw_front_wall
proto: u16 draw_front_wall(int depth, u16 y, u16 x)
purpose: Draws the cell straight ahead at depth 0..3 if solid (dungeon_cell_at(y,x) >= 0xa0) and reports whether rendering continues deeper. idx = byte table 0x2e8a[type-0xa] (a:0c b:08 c:18 d:08 e:0c f:0c) + depth, forced to 0x0c at depth 0; draw_wall_image(0,0,idx) and (1,0,idx). In style 1 (cave) a 0xc0 wall at depth 1 or 2: animate_wall_sparkle(depth, cell&7, 0x2e8b[depth*5 + (cell&7)] + 0xe, 0x5f) and the state is written back into the cell's low 3 bits. At depth 1: a 0xb0 wall with low nibble != 0 calls draw_dungeon_sign(nibble); else in style 3 a 0xc0 wall blinks eyes with probability 4/64: bright g_ui_color0, draw_hline(0x5c..0x5d,y 0x57), (0x5b..0x5d, 0x58), (0x61..0x62, 0x57), (0x61..0x63, 0x58). Returns 0 for solid cells, except a door (0xe0) at depth 0: g_clip_enabled=1 and return 1 (the view beyond is clipped to the door opening). Open cells return 1.
notes: the sparkle state table 0x2e8b overlaps 0x2e8a+1 (the image-base table is only 6 bytes)

name: draw_side_wall
proto: void draw_side_wall(int depth, int side, u16 y, u16 x)
purpose: Draws the side-wall slice at depth 0..3 for the cell (y,x) to the left (side 0) or right (side 1, mirrored). cell<0xa0: image 0x10+depth (opening). 0xa0/0xe0/0xf0 (rooms/doors): image 4+depth. 0xb0/0xd0 (walls, secret doors): image depth. 0xc0: image 0x14+depth, then only for depth<=1 in style 1: x = 0x21 (depth 0) or 0x43 (depth 1), mirrored as 0xbe-x for side 1; animate_wall_sparkle(depth, cell&7, 0x2e9a[depth*5+(cell&7)]+0xe, x) and the state stored in the cell's low 3 bits.
notes: secret doors (0xd0) look like walls from the side and front

name: animate_fountain
purpose: Plots the animated water pixels of a fountain cell at view depth 0..3 for animation frame 0..2, mirrored on both halves. Colour 0 on CGA/Hercules else g_ui_color2 (and bright +8 at depth 0 on EGA/Tandy). Depth 0: 8 (x,y) pairs at g_fountain_cycle_px (0x2ea4+frame*16) plus 1 pair at g_fountain_cycle_px2 (0x2f10+frame*2): plot (x,y) and (0xbe-x,y). Depth 1: 5 pairs (0x2ed4+frame*10): (x+0x48,y+0x60) and (0x76-x,y+0x60). Depth 2: 4 pairs (0x2ef2+frame*8): (x+0x50,y+0x60),(0x6e-x,y+0x60). Depth 3: 1 pair (0x2f0a+frame*2): (x+0x58,y+0x60),(0x66-x,y+0x60). Other depths: nothing.
notes: loop bounds in the decompile (base+0x2eb5, +11999=0x2edf, +0x2efb) give 8/5/4 pairs

name: draw_cell_contents
proto: void draw_cell_contents(int depth, u16 y, u16 x)
purpose: Draws the objects in the corridor cell at view depth 0..3 (called farthest first). c=dungeon_cell_at(y,x), t=c>>4. For t in 1..7, excluding t==6 with low bits (hidden traps/bomb): if byte table 0x2f16[t] (00 1f 00 1f 00 00 00 00) is non-zero, draw_wall_image(side,flip=1,value+depth*2) for both sides (ladder up, drawn flipped on the ceiling); if 0x2f1e[t] (00 00 1f 1f 37 27 2f 3f) is non-zero, both halves unflipped (ladder down 0x1f, chest 0x37, fountain 0x27, pit/floor hole 0x2f, open chest 0x3f); t==5 also animate_fountain(0x2f26 frame, depth). t==8: draw_energy_field(c&7, depth). Then for t<9 if the raw map cell has bit 8 (ceiling hole): both halves flipped of 0x2f24 (0x2f) + depth*2. If depth!=0 and (x&7,y&7) equals the monster position: draw_dungeon_monster(depth). At depth 0 the fountain frame 0x2f26 is incremented and wrapped to 0 after 2.
notes: item index encoding: (index+1)>>1 - 0x10 = ITEMS image, so 0x1f->0, 0x27->4, 0x2f->8, 0x37->12, 0x3f->16 plus depth

name: render_dungeon_view
purpose: Renders the 3-D view on page 1. g_disk_drive_set=0xff; set_draw_page(1); colour 0; fill_rect x 0x60..0xaf rows 0xe..0xb2 (the right half - mirrored blits OR into the page); set_clip_window(ymax 0xb7, xmax 0x98, ymin 0x2a, xmin 0x28); g_clip_enabled=0. If g_light_spell_turns==0 and g_torch_turns==0: fill_rect 8..0xb7 square black (darkness). Else from the party cell step along facing dx/dy (0x24d6/0x24de) for depth 0..3: if draw_front_wall(depth,y,x)==0 stop; unless depth==0 and (the party stands in a door cell 0xe0 or full==0), draw_side_wall(depth,0, y+0x2f2c[facing], x+0x2f28[facing]) and draw_side_wall(depth,1, y-.., x-..) (byte tables ff 00 01 00 / 00 ff 00 01, i.e. the perpendicular direction, wrapping via &7 in dungeon_cell_at). Then walk back from the last depth drawing draw_cell_contents(depth,y,x). Finally set_draw_page(0), g_clip_enabled=0.
notes: SJOG c5c6 calls it with 1; ROOT vector 1778:04ca lists it as callee only by shared address (that vector is ENDGAME)

name: redraw_dungeon_view
purpose: Full redraw used after every move/event: draw_status_window; render_dungeon_view(1); copy_rect_between_pages(y2 0xb2, x2 0xaf, y1 0xe, x1 0x10, dst 0, src 1); step_sound_tick; print_level_and_facing. Vector 1778:0476 (called by DNGLOOK a938).

name: can_use_ladder
purpose: Returns 1 if the party may move to level `level` at its current x/y. With check==0 always 1. With check!=0 returns 0 unless the destination cell's type nibble is 0 (open hallway) - the decompiled condition '(c&0xf0)!=0 || t==0xe0 || t==0xd0 || t==0xc0 || t==0xb0' collapses to 'type != 0'.
notes: check is 0 from cmd_klimb_dungeon; CAST passes 1 for the Uus Por / Des Por spells (not yet translated)

name: dungeon_klimb_ladder
purpose: Moves the party one level: dir=-1 up ('Up!' 0x6c74), +1 down ('Down!' 0x6c6c). If going up from level 0 or down from level 7 returns 1 (caller must run exit_dungeon). Otherwise can_use_ladder(check, z+dir): 0 -> 'Failed!' (0x6c7a) + play_tone_sweep(50,1,2000,800); else g_party_z += dir, g_dungeon_dir_copy = 4 (dir<1, came from below) or 5 (from above), spawn_dungeon_monster(1), redraw_dungeon_view. Returns 0 unless leaving.
notes: vector 1778:0512; CAST cd3a calls it with check=1 (spell)

name: exit_dungeon
purpose: Leaves the dungeon to the surface: g_party_x = table 0x1e89[g_location], g_party_y = 0x1eb1[g_location] (per-location entrance coordinates, indices 0x21..0x28 = f0 5b 48 7e 9c 3a ef 80 / 49 43 a8 14 1b 66 f0 80); prints '\nExit to ' then 'Britannia!' (g_party_z stays 0) if the party was on level 0, else 'Underworld!' with g_party_z = 0xff; g_location = 0.

0x1e89.name: g_location_entry_x
0x1e89.meaning: overworld x of each location's entrance (index = location)

notes: vector 1778:051e

name: cmd_attack_dungeon
purpose: Attack command inside a dungeon (ROOT dispatch_command 'A', vector 1778:052a). Prints 'Attack' (0x6caa). If the cell ahead ((x+dx[facing])&7, (y+dy[facing])&7) is not the monster's cell: 'What?' (0x6cb2), return 0. Else g_combat_flags=2, DNGLOOK b3c0, DNGLOOK aefc, DNGLOOK afce, run_encounter(0, monster type, 2). Combat exit 5: z-1 if z!=0 else exit_dungeon; exit 6: z+1 if z<7 else exit_dungeon. Then DNGLOOK b32e(1); if g_location!=0: spawn_dungeon_monster(1), redraw_dungeon_view. Returns 0.

name: cmd_klimb_dungeon
purpose: Klimb command inside a dungeon (ROOT dispatch_command 'K', vector 1778:0506). t = type of the party cell; up possible for 0x10/0x30 or when the raw cell has bit 8 (ceiling hole) and g_grapple!=0; down possible for 0x20/0x30/0x60. Both: 'Klimb-U/D-' (0x6cba) and read_command_key until one is chosen: 3 or 'U' -> up, 4 or 'D' -> down, space -> 'Pass' (neither). Neither possible: 'Klimb-what?' (0x6cea) or 'Klimb-\nWith What?' (0x6cd6, ceiling hole without grapple), return 0. One possible: 'Klimb-' (0x6cce). Then dungeon_klimb_ladder(0,-1) for up / (0,1) for down; a non-zero result (left level 0 upward / level 7 downward) calls exit_dungeon. Returns 1.
